title: Botswana — Delta, River & Salt
sub: Five days from a flooded delta to a dry white pan — tap a day to travel it: the channels, the herds, the food, where you sleep.
cap: Illustrative 5-day safari circuit · real Botswanan towns shown for bearing; camps & food generic (SO-1b). A demo a real tour operator could publish as their own — free to claim and replace with their product. AI imagery.

days.title: Into the delta by mokoro
days.summary: A light aircraft over the floodplain, then a dugout canoe poled through papyrus channels.

stops.name: Maun · safari town
stops.blurb: Dusty frontier town where every second vehicle is a converted game-viewer and every pilot is twenty-four.

stops.name: The delta from the air
stops.blurb: An inland delta that never reaches the sea — silver channels braided through ten thousand green islands.

stops.name: Poled through the papyrus
stops.blurb: Standing in the stern with a long pole, reed tips brushing past, frogs the size of a thumbnail on the stems.

stops.name: Bream on the coals
stops.blurb: Freshwater bream caught that afternoon, split, salted and grilled over a driftwood fire on an island.

stops.name: Island tented camp
stops.blurb: Six tents under wild fig trees; hippo grunting in the channel all night, close enough to feel.

days.title: Predator country
days.summary: Game drives at first and last light through a reserve known for big cats and wild dog.

stops.name: First light drive
stops.blurb: Out before the sun with a blanket and a flask; the bush is loudest in the first forty minutes.

stops.name: Wild dog on the hunt
stops.blurb: A pack of painted dogs moving at a fast trot, ears like satellite dishes, absolutely committed.

stops.name: Lions in the shade
stops.blurb: A pride flat on their backs under a leadwood, paws in the air, indifferent to everything.

stops.name: Slow-pounded beef & sorghum
stops.blurb: The national comfort dish — beef simmered for hours then pounded to threads, with fermented sorghum porridge and wild greens.

stops.name: Camp on the floodplain edge
stops.blurb: Raised decks looking over open grassland; elephants cross in front of the fire before dinner.

days.title: North to the marsh
days.summary: Deep sand tracks north into elephant country and a marsh with a fearsome reputation.

stops.name: Sand-track transfer
stops.blurb: Low range, windows down, four hours of mopane and deep sand to cover ninety kilometres.

stops.name: Elephant highway
stops.blurb: Bull elephants in single file on a path worn a metre deep by a century of the same walk.

stops.name: The marsh channel
stops.blurb: A channel that mysteriously dried up for decades, then refilled — and the game came straight back.

stops.name: Bush braai under the stars
stops.blurb: Grilled meat, pot bread baked in the coals, and a long table set out in the open with lanterns.

stops.name: Marsh-side camp
stops.blurb: Canvas under a rock ridge; lion calling somewhere south, answered twice before midnight.

days.title: The great river
days.summary: East to a river frontier where four countries almost touch and the elephants come to drink.

stops.name: East to the river
stops.blurb: Out of deep sand onto a tar road — the first hard surface in four days feels like flying.

stops.name: Riverfront herds
stops.blurb: Hundreds of elephants coming down to drink at once, calves shoulder-deep, crocodiles keeping their distance.

stops.name: Sundown on the water
stops.blurb: A flat-bottomed boat drifting with the current while the sun goes down enormous and orange behind the reeds.

stops.name: River-fish supper
stops.blurb: Grilled tilapia with chilli, lime and a cold beer on a deck built out over the water.

stops.name: Riverside lodge
stops.blurb: Thatch and timber above the bank; hippos on the lawn at 2 a.m., which the staff mention casually.

days.title: Out onto the salt
days.summary: South to a salt pan the size of a small country — a horizon with nothing on it at all.

stops.name: South from the river
stops.blurb: Green gives way to grey scrub, then to grass, then to nothing much at all.

stops.name: The pan, edge to edge
stops.blurb: A flat white plain so featureless the horizon curves; drive out onto it and the vehicle is the only vertical thing.

stops.name: Meerkats at their burrow
stops.blurb: A habituated colony that will stand on your shoulder for a better view, entirely on their own terms.

stops.name: Last supper on the salt
stops.blurb: A table, white cloth and lanterns set out on the open pan; grilled meats, cold wine, and a full 360° sunset.

stops.name: Journey's end · the pan
stops.blurb: Bedrolls on the salt, no tent, no tree, no sound — just the whole sky.
